description.text: Introduction This is to cultivate moral, intellectual as well as physical all-round development high-quality professionals who engages in modern service industry mastering the economic and trade, management and e-commercial based theory and a higher level of foreign language, commanding the application of e-commerce, e-commerce planning and system design technology and management skills with practical and innovative spirit.

duration.text: The Electonic Commerce at Central China Normal University is a 2 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3888 USD/per year ￥ 28000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number & expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6.Two letters of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents
